phases.title: Foundations — AI, Thinking & Communication
phases.description: Start with AI fluency, prompting, research habits, digital literacy, information design, and practical safety. This phase makes learners effective AI users before asking them to build systems. Expect 4-6 weeks.

phases.title: Building — Agents, Automation & AI-Powered Workflows
phases.description: Understand how LLMs work, then start shipping things. Agents, MCP, automation, RAG, research tools, data literacy, and your first AI productivity stack. By the end of this phase you will have built and used real AI systems. Expect 6-8 weeks.

phases.title: Design — Visual, UX & AI-Augmented Creation
phases.description: Design is how AI solutions feel real. UX principles, Figma, visual design, AI image and video tools. Expect 5–7 weeks.

phases.title: Technical Fluency — Code, APIs & AI Frameworks
phases.description: Python, HTML/CSS/JS, APIs, Git, LangChain, databases, deployment. Not to become a developer — to read, modify, and ship with confidence. Expect 8–12 weeks.

phases.title: Launch — Products, Users & Responsibility
phases.description: Find real problems, build real solutions, ship to real users. User research, monitoring, cost optimisation, ethics, regulation. Expect 4–6 weeks.

phases.title: Business — Strategy, Sales & Distribution
phases.description: Business models, pricing, selling, go-to-market, personal brand. AI without business thinking is a hobby. Expect 4–6 weeks.

phases.title: Mastery — Teaching, Contributing & Leading
phases.description: The highest form of learning is teaching. Contributing to research, governance, and community. You don't finish this phase — you live it. Ongoing.
